## Description

Staff request leave; an admin approves or declines. Approved doctor leave becomes a P1-012 schedule exception, which re-offers affected appointments.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Approved doctor leave creates the schedule exception once (idempotent).
- [ ] **AC2.** Declining needs a reason.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
